title: DYSPHOR1A Targets Indonesian Police Database
content_md: Summary On August 20, 2026 , the ransomware group DYSPHOR1A announced a cyberattack on the Indonesian Police Database ( inp.polri.go.id ). The attack has potentially compromised sensitive data of 52,000 police officers, including personal and contact information. Incident Report Field Details Target Indonesian Police Database Domain inp.polri.go.id Country Indonesia Attacking Group DYSPHOR1A Date Reported August 20, 2026 Threat Actor Statement “Database containing records of 52,000 Indonesian police officers including email addresses, phone numbers, first and last names, passwords, location details, and 4,000 facial photographs.” Recommended Security Actions Ransomware attacks are increasingly targeting both enterprise and mid-sized organizations across all sectors. The following steps are critical to reduce impact and prevent future incidents: Monitor continuously: Use DeXpose’s dark web and infostealer monitoring platform to detect breached credentials, leaked databases, and threat actor chatter in near real-time—before damage spreads internally.
